==Ingredients==

* 10.5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] soft (silken) [[Cookbook:Tofu|tofu]]
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 8 oz [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]], thickly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tsp|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* ½ cup dry red [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste

== Special equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Blender|Blender]]
* [[Cookbook:Skillet|Skillet]]

==Procedure==

# In a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]], blend tofu and ¼ cup water for about 2 minutes, or until smooth
# Add remaining ¾ cup water and process until blended.
# In a large skillet, [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] onion for about 5 minutes.
# Add mushrooms and thyme, and sauté 5 minutes more.
# Add wine and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 5 minutes.
# Add tofu mixture and simmer until mushrooms are wilted.
# Stir in soy sauce, and adjust salt to taste.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Using less water and/or adding some flour turns this into a delicious cream sauce for [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]].
